scope: Native color pair compare/apply plus Twitch ColorChaos conditional restoration. No live actions, full build, version bump, EffectEngine or EffectModel changes.

claims.Finding: Writes exactly current color-mode DWORD GX+23364 from ECX and strength DWORD GX+23368 from EDX after obtaining the GX singleton; does not write brightness or loaded Settings. Its own body has no mutex acquisition.
claims.Limitations: No writer-generation counter; caller must serialize the pair.

claims.Finding: Color preview wrapper uses signed CX/DX; disabled mode normalizes to (0,0), enabled strength is clamped1..10 before tailcalling125D00. New bridge conditional operation validates mode0..3 and canonical pairs before this call.
claims.Limitations: Wrapper itself does not bound the mode; bridge argument validation is required.

claims.Finding: Loaded-color restoration reads Settings fields+16/+18 and normalizes disabled/enabled strength before125D00. It is a loaded-configuration source, not a snapshot of the current preview.
claims.Limitations: Not called by ColorChaos start or end.

claims.Finding: ApplyAll invokes brightness and color separately and also applies window, framerate, controller and audio configuration. The conditional operation avoids this broad path entirely.
claims.Limitations: The claim is about concrete side effects in this complete body; no new exhaustive settings subsystem claim.

claims.Finding: Final pixel constant upload compares/copies80bytes at GX+23300 including color mode/strength at +64/+68. Changing that pair is detected by the existing memcmp; no explicit dirty write or refresh call is needed.
claims.Limitations: Other constant/resource paths in this body are retained native behavior, not called by the trainer.

claims.Finding: GX_GetDeviceSingleton uses a CRT/TLS initialization guard and returns fixed object1408A0970; its initializing path invokes the constructor. Existing bridge readiness avoids initialization as an action side effect.
claims.Limitations: The CRT guard is not a renderer-generation token.

command.match: one Color call under current revalidated captured display lease/mutex; no Brightness/Loaded call

contract.integration: Existing DisplayHandle/Capabilities/Snapshot; shared catalog/UI integrated by root.

limitations: Value comparison cannot identify identical external rewrites or ABA.
Per-operation display lease validity is not a cross-renderer generation token.
Supported native thread/mutex paths assumed; arbitrary mod memory writers are not synchronized.
No live visual validation; synthetic tests and original PE evidence.
correction: Old GameplayReadiness wording said color readbacks were absent. Existing193/194 are separate unlocked diagnostics; new465 provides a coherent pair. The old blanket loaded-restore behavior is removed for ColorChaos.
